The plate is an oval platter, roughly 30 cm long by 17 cm wide. I estimated each item from how much of the platter it covers and how tall it looks.

- **Corn:** two corn pieces, each about 5 cm long and 6 cm across. Without the cob, the kernels from both pieces weigh about 70 g. The cob is edible only in part, so I counted the whole pieces at about 120 g.
- **Cauliflower:** a cooked pile of florets about 10 cm by 6 cm, estimated at 90 g.
- **Rice:** a small mound about 8 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm high, estimated at 80 g of cooked rice.
- **Apple:** it sits at the edge of the platter, so I'm treating it as a separate item. It looks medium-sized, around 180 g, and only part of it is visible.
